metaDescription: The story of AYAS dance school: history, mission, values, experience, teachers, and groups.

hero.title: About the school
hero.lead: AYAS tells its path from passion to the stage, so the school can be trusted before the first class.

history.title: History
paragraphs: AYAS was founded from a passion for the art of dance. The school grew as a place where tradition and contemporary expression are learned in the same studio.
Over the years a way of working took shape here: movement, stage presence, and inner discipline that a student carries beyond the performance.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: We teach more than movement. Our mission is to shape artists who can express their inner world on stage, honoring tradition while staying open to a new language.

items.title: Tradition
items.body: Roots stay visible in every contemporary work.

items.title: Expression
items.body: Technique serves a personal voice and does not replace it.

items.title: Discipline
items.body: Repetition, attention, and respect for the person beside you are part of class.

items.title: Stage
items.body: Every class prepares the moment of standing before an audience.

experience.achievementsBody: The school’s experience shows on stage: in student performances, in a long path of study, and in the trust with which families choose AYAS.
achievements: Stage experience from the first classes
A community that stays with the school
experience.competitionsBody: Competition is part of preparation and stage focus. Students learn to present their work, hear the result, and return to class more precise.
experience.internationalBody: The school stays open to meetings beyond its borders: master classes, shared programs, and stages where Armenian dance practice meets other schools.

programs.title: Core training
programs.body: Regular classes for technique, musicality, and stage conduct.

programs.title: Stage preparation
programs.body: Rehearsals and performances that carry classwork to an audience.

programs.title: Open classes
programs.body: A way to meet the school before choosing a group.

practice.hallsBody: Classes take place in studios made for dance: a proper floor, mirrors, and room for the group to work alone and together.
practice.childrenBody: Children’s groups learn movement through play, order, and a first experience of the stage, with a load that fits their age.
practice.adultsBody: Adult groups are open to people starting or returning to dance: technique, expression, and community in the same class.
